senses.gloss: घुण- + अक्षर घुण- + अक्षर, n. a figure bored by a woodworm, and by accident [] resembling a letter, Rājat. 4, 167 (Pañc. 42, 12, read घुणाक्षर).
† घुण् घुण् (a dialectical form of घूर्ण्), i. 1, Ātm., i. 6, Par. To whirl.
† घुण्ण् घुण्ण् (like घिण्ण्, a dialectical form of गृह्ण्, vb. ग्रह्), i. 1, Ātm. To take.
घुण घुण, m. A wood-worm, Suśr. 1, 29, 5.
